_comment: Discord Rich Presence. Copy this file to discord.json next to it and put your own
application id in clientId, then rebuild.
Make the application at https://discord.com/developers/applications. The id is the
'Application ID' on the General Information page - it is not a secret and not a token,
it only names the application to Discord.
Under Rich Presence > Art Assets upload an image named exactly 'bestclient'; that is
the key the launcher asks for. Without it the presence still shows, just with no
With no discord.json at all, presence is simply never started.
